root_cause: marmot-ts ingest yields the processed application message, then emits authenticatedApplicationMessage, then (at batch end) save()s the advanced MLS state with a single store.setItem. The app's dispatcher receives the emit synchronously but runs its handlers asynchronously on its tail queue (several IDB round-trips), so the state save nearly always lands first. A page unload in that window persisted the advanced ratchet but never stored the rumor, which could then never be decrypted again.
fix: Write-ahead rumor journal, app-side only. New rumorJournal.ts: idb-keyval store few-rumor-journal (object store 'rumors'), key `${groupId}:${rumorId}`, value {groupId, rumorId, senderPubkey, data, receivedAt (strictly increasing)}; putRumor (idempotent), ackRumor, listPendingRumors (FIFO by receivedAt), sweepRumorJournal, clearRumorJournalForGroup, clearAllRumorJournal, createApplicationMessageJournaler(groupId). Bounds: 30-day max age, 1000 per group (= dispatcher LRU cap), enforced on every list and once per subscribe run. EpochResolver now AWAITS onApplicationMessage({rumor, data, senderPubkey}) in all three ingest loops through one helper, journalApplicationMessage, with a guard comment. It warns and continues on any failure, including an undeserializable payload, which used to throw out of the loop and skip the state save. welcomeSubscription wires the callback to the journal. Dispatcher: createDispatcher(handlers, {journal}) acks in a finally block after the handlers (also when a handler throws, and when disposal cuts the fan-out short). Work skipped because of disposal and sender-mismatched rumors are never acked. A duplicate's ack is queued on the tail, so it never runs before the original's handlers. subscription.replay(entries) feeds entries through the identical listener. buildDispatcher passes the options through. MarmotContext sweeps once per run, subscribes the dispatcher with {journal:{ack}}, then awaits listPendingRumors and calls replay before subscribeToGroupMessages. The journal is cleared in clearAllGroupData (the account-scoped clear) and per group in the leaveGroupImpl purge (new dep clearRumorJournalForGroup). collectBackupPayload is unchanged and reads only its own stores. No new publishes.

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The requested groups-contacts --repeat-each=10 cannot pass on a single wiped relay. The spec uses fixed identities and fixed DM text, so repeat N sees N+1 bubbles. Its 10x gate needs one wipe per run, which costs about 10 relay restarts. Stryker also cannot load a scratch vitest config from /tmp that imports 'vitest/config' (MODULE_NOT_FOUND); a plain-object .mjs config works.
retrospective.surprised_by: The Map-backed idb-keyval mocks used across the unit suite return rows in insertion order, while real IndexedDB returns them in key order. Ordering logic over entries() can look fully tested and still be unexercised; only the mutation run exposed the untested sort.
